# Checking the fabric {#sec-checking}

[Back to dashboard](../lab-dashboard.html)

Start with the device inventory in @tbl-inventory. The link plan is described in
@sec-underlay; both references should open the matching section of the previous
chapter.

## Verification checklist

- [ ] Every node in @tbl-inventory is running.
- [ ] Each leaf can reach both spine loopbacks through the underlay.
- [ ] Expected BGP sessions are established.
- [ ] EVPN routes are present on both leaves.
- [ ] Traffic passes between the two hosts.

## Example command output

```text
Fabric validation — illustrative output
Nodes reachable:       6 / 6
BGP sessions:          8 / 8 established
Host-to-host traffic:  passed
```

::: {.callout-warning collapse="true"}
## A failed check is a starting point

If a BGP session is down, inspect the corresponding interfaces and IP
reachability before changing the routing configuration. These instructions are
reference text; this book executes no commands.
:::
